# Define a component group for our target.
add_llvm_component_group(SimpleRISC)

# Point to the main TableGen definition file.
set(LLVM_TARGET_DEFINITIONS SimpleRISC.td)

# Define the C++ header files to be generated by TableGen.
# This is a minimal set based on the RISCV example.
tablegen(LLVM SimpleRISCGenAsmWriter.inc -gen-asm-writer)
tablegen(LLVM SimpleRISCGenDAGISel.inc -gen-dag-isel)
tablegen(LLVM SimpleRISCGenInstrInfo.inc -gen-instr-info)
tablegen(LLVM SimpleRISCGenRegisterInfo.inc -gen-register-info)
tablegen(LLVM SimpleRISCGenSubtargetInfo.inc -gen-subtarget)

# A helper target that other parts of LLVM can depend on.
add_public_tablegen_target(SimpleRISCCommonTableGen)

# Define the main CodeGen library. This lists the C++ files we will create.
add_llvm_target(SimpleRISCCodeGen
  SimpleRISCAsmPrinter.cpp
  SimpleRISCFrameLowering.cpp
  SimpleRISCISelDAGToDAG.cpp
  SimpleRISCISelLowering.cpp
  SimpleRISCInstrInfo.cpp
  SimpleRISCRegisterInfo.cpp
  SimpleRISCSubtarget.cpp
  SimpleRISCTargetMachine.cpp

  # List the other LLVM libraries our backend depends on.
  # SimpleRISCDesc and SimpleRISCInfo will be created by the subdirectories below.
  LINK_COMPONENTS
  AsmPrinter
  CodeGen
  Core
  MC
  SelectionDAG
  SimpleRISCDesc
  SimpleRISCInfo
  Support
  Target

  # Add this library to our main component group.
  ADD_TO_COMPONENT
  SimpleRISC
  )

# Include the subdirectories that every backend needs.
# These will define the SimpleRISCDesc and SimpleRISCInfo libraries.
add_subdirectory(MCTargetDesc)
add_subdirectory(TargetInfo)
